_comment: Single source of truth for the SiteGround Git release boundary. Consumed by scripts/deployment/siteground-git-release.sh (bash) and drywalltoolbox/wp/wp-content/mu-plugins/dtb-deployment/Services/ProtectedPathPolicy.php (PHP). Both must be kept in sync with this file; do not duplicate the lists elsewhere.
git_scope: Paths are relative to the SiteGround Git repository root, which is the production /wp application tree only. The site root (frontend build, root .htaccess, logos) is out of scope for this system and continues to deploy via the existing operator-managed FileZilla path.
